headline: Paddy Power cuts 1,400 jobs following UK betting tax increases
summary: Paddy Power is cutting 1,400 jobs after the government increased taxes on online casino and sports betting in the previous budget.
why: Changes in government taxation directly impact operating expenses and profit margins for the gaming and leisure sector.

impacts.name: Gambling & Entertainment
impacts.why: Higher regulatory taxes reduce net profitability, forcing firms to restructure and cut costs.
